description: This file contains utility functions for handling image conversion, message creation, and display logic for a chat UI component, specifically related to multimodal content such as images and PDFs.

methods.name: convertImageToBase64
methods.description: Converts a File object to a base64-encoded string, resolving with the base64 data without the data URL prefix.

methods.name: createMultimodalMessage
methods.description: Creates a message object containing text and an image or PDF encoded in base64 for multimodal chat interactions.

methods.name: createDisplayMessage
methods.description: Constructs a display message including input text and optional file attachment information and preview.

methods.name: shouldShowAttachedImage
methods.description: Determines if an image or PDF attachment should be visually displayed based on message content and presence of a preview URL.
